data.name: Gayatri
data.gender_notes: Gayatri is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A Vedic metre; a hymn; the mother of the Vedas
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root gai, 'to sing' — gāyatrī, a Vedic metre and hymn. Its root is Sanskrit gai (गै). The Gayatri Mantra, a central Vedic hymn. Gayatri is a Sanskrit name meaning “A Vedic metre; a hymn; the mother of the Vedas”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gayatri expresses “A Vedic metre; a hymn; the mother of the Vedas”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root gai, 'to sing' — gāyatrī, a Vedic metre and hymn.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gayatri total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
